Once those ticket updates are in, I'll configure the feature flag with: max concurrency at 100, EU tenant group excluded, human review required for external responses, and a named escalation channel. If any of those pieces aren't confirmed by Monday, we'll need to slip the beta launch. Does anyone see any blockers to getting this done by end of day Monday?
